history.title: Local message history and export
history.privacy: History copies stay in this browser's IndexedDB, separated by environment and account ID, without extra uploads or cloud backup. Live game traffic still uses the existing Cloudflare relay. History is not encrypted: people using this browser, same-origin code and permitted extensions may read it. Disable saving on shared devices.
history.cleanup: Recent contacts are kept for up to 30 days; message content for up to 7 days. Expired records are deleted individually while this site is open, not while it is closed. Clearing site data, private browsing or storage pressure may erase history.
history.shorten: Reducing retention permanently deletes saved records older than the new limit. Continue?
history.error: Local history could not be read or saved. Check browser storage permission and space. Chat still works.
history.includePrivate: Include private messages and whispers (file contains private content)
history.clearConfirm: Delete saved messages and recent contacts for this account and environment? Other accounts and currently displayed messages are unaffected. This cannot be undone.
m002: Could not load interaction text. Raw keys are shown; reload to retry.
m003: Local storage is unavailable. Saving or deletion may not have completed; check this site's browser storage. Login remains available.
m004: Remember account is optional and off by default. Only your account name is saved as plain text in this browser's localStorage for this site (bc-lite-account-v1). No password is saved and no account-storage service is contacted. The name remains after logout; uncheck this option or clear site data to remove it. Same-origin scripts, permitted extensions, people using this device, or a compromised site may read it. Avoid shared devices. Assess and accept the local-storage risks before enabling it. This is not an encrypted vault and is separate from your browser's password manager.

m061: Display preferences stay in this browser. Manage message retention and daily exports under Storage. Passwords are never written to local history.
m064: Data flows from your browser through the Cloudflare relay to BC. Credentials and game traffic pass through the relay; this is not browser-to-BC end-to-end encryption. This version adds no analytics, account-storage API, database or packet logging. We cannot guarantee that a deployer has not modified it, or control platform logging and BC's data handling. Only use a deployment you trust.

m068: This is not full ECHO: no clothing rendering, wardrobe or fake plugin version. Normal operations do not overwrite appearance; confirmed safewords are an exception and save appearance, but never change OnlineSharedSettings. Another ECHO user must verify your outfit. Inline chat images and videos load from their hosts only after you grant origin permission, which receive your IP and other connection information.
m069: Save your outfit in full BC with ECHO before using Lite. Do not change outfits during a Lite session; check again in the full client afterward. Viewers without ECHO cannot see its custom clothing.

m080: Login traffic passes through Cloudflare to BC. This version does not log packets, but third parties still handle the connection. Logging in disconnects other sessions of the same account.

safety.title: Safeword
stability.title: Connection and background aids
stability.help: Returning to the foreground checks the connection; temporary disconnects trigger one room rejoin attempt. Screen wake lock works only in the foreground. Optional local audio loops without uploading the file; background playback cannot guarantee BC stays connected. These options last only for this tab session and stop on logout.
stability.awakeReleased: Screen wake lock released or suspended
stability.unsupported: Screen wake lock is unsupported or denied by the system
stability.playing: Audio playing; this does not confirm the BC connection
stability.selected: Audio selected. Press Play to start
stability.selectedNeeded: Choose a local audio file first
stability.audioError: Audio playback failed or was blocked; retry or choose another file
safety.wait: A safeword was just sent. Please wait before trying again.
safety.help: Safewords change and save your appearance. Restore: return to this login's appearance and pose, restrict interactions to whitelist or stricter, and stay in the room. Release: remove known BC item groups and leave; keep clothing, unknown plugin groups and an owned SlaveCollar. Unknown plugin restraints and special item dependencies may not be released.
safety.confirm: Run “{0}”? This synchronizes your appearance to BC and cannot be undone here.
safety.disabled: Your BC account has not confirmed safewords are enabled, or this is a GGTS room. Check your settings in full BC first; Lite does not bypass restrictions.
safety.unavailable: This safeword operation cannot be performed.
safety.noBackup: No appearance backup is available for this login. Please sign in again.
safety.noCurrent: Current appearance has not arrived yet. Wait for room synchronization and try again.
safety.releaseUnsupported: Item release is not supported for this character type. You can still restore the login appearance.
safety.sent: Safeword and appearance updates sent; server persistence is not confirmed. Verify in full BC or with another player.
safety.command: Use the room's Safeword button to choose and confirm an operation. /safeword is not sent as ordinary chat.
site.description: A mobile-first Bondage Club chat client with room search, friends, whispers, private chat and activity text, without full character rendering.
action.use: SourceCharacter uses NextAsset on DestinationCharacter's FocusAssetGroup.
action.remove: SourceCharacter removes PrevAsset from DestinationCharacter's FocusAssetGroup.
action.swap: SourceCharacter replaces DestinationCharacter's PrevAsset with NextAsset.
media.help: Only approved HTTPS origins load media. Session grants end on logout or tab close; permanent grants are saved locally. Revoking cannot undo previous requests.
media.storageError: Could not save the origin settings; the operation was not completed.
private.title: Private
afc.title: Extended lovers (AFC)
afc.unavailable: Room requests require an AFC lover on your friends list.
reply.unavailable: Replied message is not in the current history
interaction.title: Interactions
interaction.help: Sends readable action text; no outfit changes, plugin effects or BC activity stats.
summon.title: BCX-compatible summons
summon.help: These are Lite permissions, not the BCX private rule engine. When enabled, only listed accounts sending matching ordinary BEEPs with a room name can prompt a summon. You confirm before moving; BCX control packets receive no response.
summon.invalid: Enter valid member IDs and nonempty summoning text.
summon.expired: Summon expired or is no longer permitted.
native.help: Lite does not disable ordinary interactions because you are bound or gagged. Required items, target access, preferences and room rules still apply. Only available actions appear by default; All actions shows restrictions and skips unimplemented checks. Hover for reasons. Not the full BC engine; cuddling needs confirmation.
interaction.noAvailable: No available activities for this zone under the current conditions.
cuddle.help: Real cuddle: wear your own pairing item and share positioning. The peer needs to accept or use ECHO.
cuddle.confirm: Replace your current ItemMisc item/pair and cuddle? Lite only changes your own slot. Lite peers must confirm; other clients follow their plugin rules. Existing partners cannot be identified without shared pairing data. Release from torso actions; cross-room following is not supported.
cuddle.changed: ItemMisc or pairing changed. Review both players again before confirming.
cuddle.occupied: Your or the peer's ItemMisc slot is occupied
cuddle.movement: Movement with current leg/feet equipment or pose cannot be verified
privacy.lastRoom: Login attempts to rejoin your previous room. The last successfully joined room name is stored in localStorage per player ID and server environment, without passwords or chat content. Leaving manually or a rejected join stops automatic return to that room. If storage is blocked, only BC's last-room data is available.
performance.title: Performance settings
performance.help: Keep 3000 room messages in memory and display 100 per batch by default. Smaller batches reduce DOM and media work. IndexedDB retention is configured separately under Storage and is not limited by these display settings.
performance.trim: Reducing the limit permanently discards excess older messages. Continue?
chat.clearConfirm: Clear local room history? Other players and private history are not affected.
interaction.textOnly: Text only: no item, stat or position pairing effects
native.target: Invalid activity target or body part
native.room: Activities blocked or map distance cannot be verified
native.data: Missing complete character, zone or activity preferences
native.equipment: Unknown or dynamic equipment prevents complete checks; known restrictions still apply
native.preferences: Some activity preferences are unavailable for complete checks
native.unsupported: Activity needs unsupported conditions or local effects
native.effects: Available; Lite does not simulate all local arousal and expression effects
native.permission: Activity or zone disabled in preferences
native.blocked: Current equipment effects or body-zone restrictions prevent this activity
stability.gap: Connection interrupted: messages may be missing. Reconnecting does not restore missed history.
connection.retained: Read and edit drafts only. Send manually after reconnection. If reconnection has stopped, log out and sign in again.
sounds.title: Message sounds
sounds.help: Separate BEEP and whisper tones, off by default. Enabling plays a sample. No desktop notifications. Browser or system rules may block background sound.
sounds.beep: Play a sound for incoming BEEP
sounds.whisper: Play a sound for incoming whispers
sounds.failed: Could not save or play the sound setting. Check browser audio support and try again.
searchHistory.title: Search local history
searchHistory.help: Search this account's unexpired local history. Private messages are excluded by default. Results never change rooms or send text.
searchHistory.resultHelp: Select a result to view context from the same room or conversation.
searchHistory.dates: The start date must not be after the end date.
searchHistory.unavailable: This message expired, was deleted, or was not saved.
history.exportError: Export failed. If a message exceeds Excel limits, use HTML or TXT.
follow.held: Leashed by #{0}; valid room changes are checked before following.
follow.unavailable: Cannot follow: destination unavailable or permission changed.
media.acvHelp: When enabled, supported website links offer a watch/listen button without a permission prompt. When disabled, they remain hyperlinks. Players load only on click; outgoing URLs stay unchanged. Direct image and media files still use origin permissions.
delivery.unconfirmed: Unconfirmed (delayed or disconnected). Check chat before resending.
